cmd_commands: Commands (run without arguments to open interactive console UI):
cmd_tui: Open interactive console dashboard (default when launched directly)
cmd_tray: Launch system tray / background proxy daemon
cmd_restore: Restore original binaries, JS files, and app.asar
cmd_ru_install: Download & install Antigravity Desktop Russian localization (add --force for unsupported version)
cmd_ru_restore: Rollback Antigravity Desktop Russian localization (restore original app.asar)
cmd_proxy: Start local bypass proxy on 127.0.0.1:38451 (or next free loopback port)
cmd_clean: Remove all traces, patches, backups, and proxies
cmd_status: Show current patch, localization, and proxy status
scan_manual_not_found: No Antigravity installation found at path: %s
patch_binary_noop: No patchable signature found in binary (file already modified or unsupported build — reinstall Antigravity / extension if needed).
patch_proxy_var_warn: Warning: https_proxy literal not found in %s; local proxy channel unavailable for this binary.
asar_modern_skip: Detected v2.4+ Desktop architecture in app.asar (JS patch not needed).
patch_js_noop: No patchable signature found in JS (file already modified or JS patch not required — skipped).
patch_complete: Patching complete. Please restart Antigravity if it was running.
proxy_foreign_warn: Warning: Another proxy is already configured (%s = %s); %s was not set.
proxy_env_warn: Warning: Could not set proxy env var: %v
proxy_env_clean_warn: Warning: Could not remove proxy env var: %v
proxy_sudo_warn: Warning: Running proxy under sudo is not recommended; run without sudo so %s reaches your desktop session.
proxy_linux_env_tip: Tip: If launching Antigravity/agy from this shell, run: export %s=%s
err_permission_sudo: Hint: System installation is owned by root. Retry with sudo (e.g. sudo agpatcher %s).
clean_start: Cleaning up patches, backups, archives, and proxy configuration...
status_ru_pack: Desktop RU localization: installed=%v, version=%s, backup=%v
ru_install_ok: Desktop RU localization v%s installed. Restart Antigravity Desktop.
ru_install_unsupported: Desktop v%s is not in antigravity-ru (available: %s). Retry with --force to use latest.
ru_restore_start: Rolling back Antigravity Desktop Russian localization...
ru_restore_ok: Desktop RU localization removed and original app.asar restored.
ru_restore_noop: Desktop RU localization is not installed (nothing to roll back).
ru_restore_nobak: Removed web_bundle_ru, but app.asar.original_backup was not found.

cmd_install: Install Antigravity on Linux from a .tar.gz archive
li_cli_linux_only: The install command unpacks Linux .tar.gz bundles and is only available on Linux.
li_cli_no_archive: No Antigravity*.tar.gz archive found. Specify path: agpatcher install --path <file.tar.gz>

tui_li_desc_scope_system: In %s — system-wide, requires sudo (Enter: cycle, Space: custom path).

tui_li_desc_desktop: Extracts icon.png from app.asar and registers Antigravity in GNOME/KDE menu.

tui_li_desc_bin: Creates a wrapper script in ~/.local/bin/antigravity (or /usr/local/bin for /opt).
tui_li_desc_patch: Patches language_server right after extraction (ineligible + AGY_PROXY_U).
